description: IME token acquisition failure ('Failed to get AAD token. len = N using client id ... and resource id ..., errorCode = N', IntuneTokenManager, IntuneManagementExtension.log). Complements IME-TOKEN-SUCCESS: an auth outage (WAM broken, conditional access, network) previously left every check-in silently doing nothing with no timeline evidence. errorCode can be empty when IME logged none; the agent dedups to one Warning per distinct code. Verified against IME 1.97 and 1.104 decompiled sources.
